abilities.name: Rest

abilities.name: Wait

abilities.name: Pick up

abilities.name: Eat

abilities.name: Gather accessible material

abilities.name: Drop

abilities.effects: Other actors may subsequently collect the ground stack.

abilities.name: Give

abilities.effects: Actual recipient identity and distance required; no relationship or happiness is inferred.

abilities.name: Message

abilities.effects: Delivered after the round barrier; recipient text is data, not authority.

reviews.reason: No implemented interface performs an attentive observation and records its completion against a natural object's observable state. Waiting and gathering are not functionally equivalent. Suitable natural targets exist, but visibility and interaction range must be checked at actual use. This capability can record experience without introducing a wellbeing reward. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.specification: Implement versioned public interface observe_nature with JSON schema {type:"object",properties:{target:{type:"string",minLength:1,maxLength:1000}},required:["target"],additionalProperties:false}. Prerequisite: individually complete 1 round of study after implementation. Execution occupies 2 consecutive simulation rounds at the actor's current position, costs 1 energy per active round, and retains normal metabolism without rest recovery. Require energy >=2 and satiety >=4 at initiation; on each active round require positive satiety, sufficient energy, and a still-existing natural plant or geological feature personally visible under existing observation permissions and within the engine's interaction range of its actual geometry. Do not move the actor or bypass solid collision, occlusion, or range rules. Interrupt on movement, incompatible action, lost eligibility, or lost target; retain elapsed time and spent costs but emit no successful completion. Maintain bounded per-actor active state {target,startTick,elapsed} and a completion history using existing bounded event/memory storage. On completion emit one successful nature_observed event containing actor, target, position, start/end ticks and a snapshot of only currently observable target properties; bind the same event to the actor's personal memory and a brief observation-complete presentation with target highlight only while visible. Observation consumes no target stock, alters no object, and grants no information beyond permissions. No new mental satisfaction source, physical comfort modifier, health effect or ongoing benefit is registered; completion alone changes neither wellbeing nor protected scoring. Depend on existing action scheduling, visibility, geometry, energy/metabolism, event validation and memory/rendering adapters. Migrate by registering the interface and event handler, initializing absent active/history state empty, preserving existing identities, stock and validated history, and granting no retroactive events or mastery. Review and implementation advance no simulation time; study and actual execution are separate.

It is a reasonable new capability; use requires actual owned stones, suitable ground and completed work, none of which are supplied by approval. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.specification: Implement versioned arrange_stone_mosaic with public schema {x:number,y:number,offsets:[{dx:number,dy:number}]} (additionalProperties:false; 2–8 offsets). Each offset represents one owned stone unit; select inventory stacks deterministically and retain provenance. Require mastery, positive satiety, energy >=6, and a visible placement disk of radius 0.5 within 0.65 of the actor. Stone centers must lie within that disk, be at least 0.16 apart, remain inside world bounds, and avoid solid geometry, existing arrangements and occupied work areas. Reserve the footprint and escrow the required stones atomically. Work takes three consecutive stationary rounds at 2 energy per round with normal metabolism; revalidate reach, clearance, positive satiety and sufficient energy each round. Movement, incompatible action or failed validation interrupts, releasing reservation and returning escrow to inventory without refunding spent energy; actor removal drops escrow at the work site. Completion converts escrow into a persistent mosaic object with stable ID, creator, creation tick, offsets, unit quantities and provenance, and emits one successful mosaic_completed event plus a personal craftsmanship record. Stones are committed, not destroyed or duplicated. Render actual stone positions in the normal visibility system; expose inspectable contents and creator. Mosaic footprint prevents overlapping placements but is walkable, non-solid, supplies no facility benefit, shade, insulation or ongoing production. Extend nearby pickup to dismantle a mosaic only by its creator within interaction reach, charging existing pickup mass costs and atomically removing it while returning its actual stones; no completion event on dismantling. No mental satisfaction or physical-comfort bonus is introduced. Bind progress, cancellation, completion and removal to event, rendering and personal-memory adapters; record events idempotently. Depend on existing inventory, round/metabolism, geometry, visibility, ownership, pickup and event systems. Migrate with empty mosaic/work collections and no retroactive objects, records, rewards or mastery; preserve existing source history and validate conserved stone totals.
